title: Earliest track: Production expands to sixty per cent
notes: Adds prod-emea-central-04 at thirty per cent, doubling Production from thirty to sixty. Fourth point on the accelerating curve of 5, 15, 30, 60, 100.
This is the largest single jump before the final commitment, which is what makes least-populated-first worth doing: the increments grow rather than repeat.
Verified before writing this step: thirty per cent held exactly, reported identically by demo-pricing in Node.js and demo-checkout in TypeScript, so the two languages agree on the same targeting.
One more step after this one takes Production to a hundred, then s015 clears the rules and serves true, freezing targeting for the seven-day window.
